question.text: What is the minimum experience required of an independent valuer in the valuation of unlisted securities to be eligible for engagement by a Cat I/II AIF?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per PDF Section 11.12: 'The independent valuer shall have at least 3 years of experience in valuation of unlisted securities.' This is a bright-line minimum. The Trap: 1/2 years understate; 5 years overstates (it's the norm for statutory auditor firm rotation, which is a different framework). 3 years is the SEBI-specified floor. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C and XIX-A both test the same minimum. IBBI Registered Valuer rules under Companies Act Sec 247 have separate work-experience norms (typically more onerous).
